criteria.summary: Project and source were created through the public product flow.
Ingestion job reached succeeded state and is visible in the report.
Chunking, contextualization and dense fake embeddings produced indexed evidence.
Chat returned a non-empty answer with at least one citation.
Report includes public follow-up commands for inspection.
Hosted providers, rerank and Neo4j remain opt-in outside the default gate.

extra_metadata.content:
# Adaptive RAG first run

Adaptive RAG first run creates a local project, ingests Markdown, indexes
chunks, and answers cited questions without hosted providers.

## Evidence

The onboarding path proves authoring, ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and chat
are wired together for a local-first product flow.
